Sample.evidence_source: [page/3/Text/6] The current study examined the efficacy of FB-IPT in a sample of 42 treatment-seeking preadolescents (ages 7–12) who met DSM-IV criteria for a depressive disorder. Preadolescents with depression were randomized to FB-IPT or child-centered therapy (CCT), a supportive and nondirective treatment that closely approximates the standard of care for pediatric depression in community mental health29.
